Matched titles open in the selected TV & movies app (Nuvio or Stremio), and YouTube cards open as a title search in SmartTube. A small badge briefly confirms each redirect when this app is allowed to display over other apps. Your TMDB key is stored in this app\'s private local preferences and is sent only to TMDB for title lookup.

Use this when your TV blocks enabling the accessibility service after a normal APK installation. Your Windows PC and TV must be on the same local network, and Nuvio (or your selected target app) must already be installed on the TV. The full guide is INSTALL_ADB.md in the project repository.
1. Download Android SDK Platform-Tools for Windows on your PC, extract the ZIP, and put the GTV2STREAM APK beside adb.exe. Get your own free TMDB v3 API key from themoviedb.org/settings/api.

2. On the TV: Settings > System > About, select Android TV OS build seven times, then in Developer options turn on USB debugging plus Network debugging or Wireless debugging. Note the TV\'s IP address.
3. In a Command Prompt opened inside the platform-tools folder, connect to the TV:
If the TV needs pairing, open Developer options > Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code, keep that screen visible, then run:
Enter the pairing code shown on the TV, then connect using the separate connection port shown on the main Wireless debugging screen:
4. Install the APK (Success confirms it worked):

TCL TVs may block the service from starting even after it shows Enabled (vendor auto-start protection). Open Android Settings > Apps > GTV2STREAM and allow Auto-start, or run this from the same Command Prompt:

5. Configure GTV2STREAM: enter your TMDB v3 key and select Save TMDB key. Pick your TV & movies target (Nuvio or Stremio). YouTube redirects use SmartTube. Open Accessibility Settings, enable GTV2STREAM recommendation redirect, and confirm the status shows Enabled — Ready. If the status says the TV is blocking the service, follow the auto-start step above. If you use multiple Nuvio profiles, enable Remember last profile in Nuvio.

Troubleshooting: "adb" is not recognized — run cmd from inside the platform-tools folder so adb.exe is present. Connection refused on port 5555 — use the wireless debugging pairing route instead. Pairing succeeded but connect failed — pairing and connection use different ports. Accessibility service still unavailable — ADB helps but is not guaranteed on every TV build. Install failed — confirm the APK name beside adb.exe and keep the TV connected.
6. After setup you can turn the debugging options back off; GTV2STREAM needs no PC or ADB connection for daily use.
